Every doctor and member of staff I have seen has been amazing. They all go above and beyond. I have had some serious medical conditions and each time I've been dealt with seriously and with care. The phone is answered promptly and politely. They are never intrusive. Appointments are always easy to obtain and you are seen very quickly. The secretaries who organise paperwork are insanely fast. If I order a prescription online through my portal, I know the chemist will have it within about an hour.
On a few occasions I've had to have very long telephone or face to face conversations about my care, and have never felt I've been rushed.
I'm currently looking at moving slightly out of the catchment for my surgery and the one reason holding me back from a house move, is I would lose the care of this amazing team.
